scripts.text:
insert into [rpy].[Supplier_Data]
(ADDRESS1,ADDRESS2,ADDRESS3,ADDRESS4,CITY,COUNTRY,COUNTY,EMAIL_ADDRESS,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
PARTY_ID,PARTY_NAME,PARTY_NUMBER,PARTY_TYPE,POSTAL_CODE,PRIMARY_PHONE_AREA_CODE,PRIMARY_PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE,
PRIMARY_PHONE_NUMBER,PROVINCE,STATE,STATUS,source_name,sub_source_name,created_date_time)
select
a.ADDRESS1,a.ADDRESS2,a.ADDRESS3,a.ADDRESS4,a.CITY,a.COUNTRY,a.COUNTY,a.EMAIL_ADDRESS,a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE,a.
PARTY_ID,a.PARTY_NAME,a.PARTY_NUMBER,a.PARTY_TYPE,a.POSTAL_CODE,a.PRIMARY_PHONE_AREA_CODE,a.PRIMARY_PHONE_COUNTRY_CODE,a.
PRIMARY_PHONE_NUMBER,a.PROVINCE,a.STATE,a.STATUS,a.source_name,a.sub_source_name,a.created_date_time
from [rpy].[Supplier_Data_stage] a,
(select PARTY_ID,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,max(ID) as ID 
from [rpy].[Supplier_Data_stage]
group by PARTY_ID,LAST_UPDATE_DATE) b
where a.PARTY_ID = b.PARTY_ID
and a.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = b.LAST_UPDATE_DATE

sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat('SELECT ','''',pipeline().parameters.p_pl_projectid,'''',' Project_id
	   ,','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.function_code,'''',' function_code
	   ,','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.source_name,'''',' source_name
	   ,','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.sub_source_name,'''',' sub_source_name
	   ,','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.class_name,'''',' class_name
	   ,','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.sub_class_name,'''',' sub_class_name
	   ,','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.unit_of_measure,'''',' unit_of_measure
	   ,','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.pim_code,'''',' pim_code
	   ,','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.roc_code,'''',' roc_code
	   ,ph.Code Phase_Code
	   ,wa.Code WorkArea_Code
	   ,su.Code WorkUnit_Code
	   ,sr.Code ScheduleResource_Code
	   ,act.CWP cwp_code
	   ,act.Activity
       ,cwp.[Name] iwp_Code
	   ,DateWorked
       ,EmployeeID
,(select max( +', '''','JDE.','''',' + ','''','00','''',' + left(pi.contract,3) + ','''','.','''',' + ltrim(rtrim(pi.contract)) + ','''','.','''',' + ltrim(rtrim(pi.costtype)) + ','''','.','''',' + ltrim(rtrim(pi.costingcoa)))
  FROM PM_ProgressItem pi with (NOLOCK)
  left outer join SP_ProgressItem_CWP picwp  with (NOLOCK) on pi.id = picwp.ProgressItemID
where CWPID  = tme.ConstructionWorkPackID) as coa_value
	   ,sum([HoursWorked]) Spent_Hours  
  FROM [dbo].[TM_EmployeeHoursWorked] tme with (NOLOCK)
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[SP_ConstructionWorkPack] cwp with (NOLOCK) ON tme.ConstructionWorkPackID = cwp.ID
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[PM_Activity] act with (NOLOCK) ON cwp.ActivityID = act.ID
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[PM_ProjectMasterData] p with (NOLOCK) ON p.Project <> ','''','ssssss','''','
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[SP_ScheduleResource] sr with (NOLOCK) ON cwp.ScheduleResourceID = sr.ID
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[SP_Unit] su with (NOLOCK) ON act.ScheduleUnit = su.Code
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[SP_WorkArea] wa with (NOLOCK) ON act.ScheduleWorkArea = wa.Code
  LEFT JOIN [dbo].[SP_Phases] ph with (NOLOCK) ON wa.PhaseID = ph.ID
  where tme.DateWorked >= ','''',activity('lk_get_pipeline_parameters').output.firstRow.start_date,'''',' group by tme.ConstructionWorkPackID,p.Project,ph.Code
	   ,wa.Code
	   ,su.Code
	   ,sr.Code 
	   ,act.CWP
	   ,act.Activity
       ,cwp.[Name]
	   ,DateWorked
       ,EmployeeID')
